$comment: Spec 124 §5 R-BA gate I #34 (R-X) — every staleness.fingerprint_inputs entry declared by a converted step needs an adjudicated disposition row here: "executed" (a named executor.{file,symbol} genuinely reads it), "descriptive" (declared, documents intent, 0 readers today), or "retire" (dead, should be removed from the descriptor). Measured 2026-09-26: all 29 distinct entries were 0-reader. Reconciled 2026-10-03 with registry-truth ruling 1 (FLEET-2 P2-C6): the retired link_massing full-gate module's row went with it; the remaining 28 are real imports (24) or declared data signals (4), still 0-reader, so every row below stays "descriptive". A future step that wires a real executor over one of these entries must flip its row to "executed" with executor.{file,symbol} in the SAME commit (R-X: an unexecuted "executed" claim is a rotted citation, checked live by dispositionRowFindings).

spec_version.$comment: identity.spec_version per-step disposition (registry-truth fold 8c item 8, home ruled by fold 8d item 8; ravines per fold 12 F3). x-trust class of the field: executed:scripts/lib/step/acquire.js#acquireExternal — but ONLY on the INGESTOR skip path. Every converted step that does not execute it is named here with why, so the gap stays visible (Phase 3 exit: not D). Locked by src/tests/spec-version-disposition.infra.test.ts (every converted step exactly once; executed == the INGESTOR set; executor resolves).
